character: Yvette Delacroix and Detective O'Riley over the intercom
voice: Yvette is fluent, playful, and knowingly suggestive; O'Riley remains boastful without stage-Irish spelling.

entries.text: The intercom crackles and you overhear a conversation:
Oh, my love, how do you manage to do it so many times?
A man has to do what a man has to do.
And you do it so well!
Keep your voice down, Yvette. Someone might hear us.
Let them hear, mon amour. We have only one life to enjoy.
I do at least fifty every day to stay in shape.
Fifty! My. And what do you call this movement?
Sit-ups. I also do fifty push-ups each day. Then I run a few miles.
